lines.en: : There better be a damn good explanation for this.
Needing somewhere private to discuss things that isn’t on the complete opposite side of town (IE: my apartment), I wind up summoning the Apocalypse Squad to the local porn shop.
Could we have found somewhere better? Probably. But I figured it would be nice to bring Makoto somewhere comfortable so she isn’t too taken aback by all she’s about to hear.
And there are few things that make her more comfortable than a building full of rubber penises and fake vaginas that also happens to be her childhood home.
: There is a good explanation for this, I swear. And no, before you go assuming things, it isn’t sexual.
: Great, thanks for clearing that up. Call me a pervert, but meandering through aisles of lubricant and ball-gags gave me a different idea.
: I mean, it can be sexual if you want. If that’s the case, we can take a short break before getting down to the real reason I asked the two of you to come here.
: Out with it.
: If you insist.
: You know what I meant, you pathetic waste of a human.
: Well, you don’t have to be rude about it.
: You know, I’m all for a good movie night every once in a while. But I’m not really sure how I feel about this choice of film. Or why we have to do it here when there’s a much bigger TV at my house.
: We have to do this here because I encountered something very unexpected just a short while ago.
: Please keep your new fetishes to yourself. Thank you.
: Is it true that...you three, like...uhh...how do I even put this?
: Makoto knows about the resets.
: Makoto knows what? How? This loop’s barely just begun.
: Well, to say she knows about the resets isn’t exactly accurate. She just...wasn’t changing the topic whenever I brought them up, so I figured I’d call the two of you right away to prove it.
: You’re not pregnant, are you? Asking for Maya’s sake.
: Uhh...no?
: Okay. I figured. I just thought I’d make sure. Again, for Maya’s sake.
: What do you know? What did he tell you so far?
: Not much...Miku just started repeating the same thing over and over again and...before I knew it, we were here. I’ve got absolutely no idea what any of this is about.
: What do you mean “repeating the same thing over and over again?”
: Whenever Sensei brought up the...time stuff.
: Makoto tried too. But it was like Miku got stuck in some sort of...interjection loop. Not to be confused with the loops we’re stuck in.
: It’s not true, is it? Sensei’s very likely just...misunderstanding something, isn’t he? It’s entirely impossible for humans to move through time like you’re suggesting.
: And the idea of a repeating timeline is just-
: It’s true. Though, I have absolutely no clue whatsoever about why you’re suddenly exempt from the same rules that keep everyone else confined to blissful ignorance.
: But, yet again, I couldn’t come up with a reason why Yumi and Tsuneyo were exempt last time, so...back to the drawing board, I guess.
: Huh...yeah...drawing any similarities between the three of them seems almost impossible. Each one of them is wildly different from one another.
: Can one of you two please explain in better terms what’s going on? Is something wrong with Miku? Is something wrong with me?
: To say anything is wrong with anyone isn’t entirely accurate as I believe there is a problem with the world itself.
: Every several months, before the school year comes to an end, the four of us, as well as everyone else we know, are sent back to an earlier part of the year in which everything starts anew.
: Except it technically isn’t an earlier part of the year. We just think it is while our city manages to move through time normally.
: The seasons still change and the tangible developments in the environment still...well, develop.
: Until recently, I was the only one whose memories carried over from loop to loop. But changes made to the formula of this for unknown reasons have now landed both Ayane and Sensei beside me.
: I take it you’ve already realized by now how suspicious it is that what should be a single school year is packed with years' worth of memories, yes?
: The reason for that is, I think, because of Sensei.
: He seems to be the anchor for everyone and the fact that his mind isn’t being reset along with the world means the rest of your memories are carrying over as well.
: It’s a phenomenon I’ve never encountered to this extent before and I imagine it’s only a matter of time until more people like yourself start catching onto this.
: I...what? Huh? But none of that makes any sense.
: Just wait until she gets to the part about everyone turning invisible and how we all have to hug on top of the roof to make things go back to normal.
: Okay. That’s enough. The joke’s over. I don’t get why all three of you decided to mess with me like this, but it’s gone way too far.
: I know how it sounds, but it’s not a joke.
: The only thing we can do now is dress you up like a shrine maiden and hope for the best.
: You’re not helping!
: Makoto, as the newest member of our time travel club that is tentatively named the “Rooftop Apocalypse Squad” I know exactly how confusing this all sounds.
: In fact, parts of it still feel like a dream to me sometimes. But after seeing it with my own eyes, I can promise you it’s not a joke.
: Why would I believe you, though? We’re not close or anything. And you’re so obsessed with Sensei that you’d probably just go along with whatever he says anyway.
: Do you really think I would go through with plotting out an extremely elaborate plan just to play a prank on you? I complain when I have to sign my name. This would be way too much effort for me.
: You’ve toyed with me plenty of times in the past. I wouldn’t put it past you to do something like that again.

: If you don’t believe us, why not try speaking about this to any of the other girls? Worst case scenario is you just get ignored again. Best case, we find more people like you and settle your doubts.
: I’ve got nothing to lose either way.
: Maya, be a little more sensitive. This is clearly really scary and weird for Makoto.
: It’s weird for all of us. It was weird enough when you wound up on the roof, but for Makoto of all people to get sucked into this as well is all sorts of confusing.
: What do you mean “of all people?” How am I supposed to take that?
: Beats me. Take it however you want. I’m still trying to wrap my head around this.
: What should we do now? Weren’t we looking for some sort of way to test more reset-centered info? I did my part. It’s your turn now.
: Guys, stop treating Makoto like she’s some sort of experiment. Like yeah, this might help us find out some stuff, but she’s still a normal girl at the end of the day. It’s not like she wanted this.
: I’ll care a little more about her “totally real” feelings if she winds up making it to the roof. For now, she’s just one more enigma.
: You mean like how you started caring about my feelings once I made it to the roof? You sure you don’t wanna ask Makoto to abstain from having sex with Sensei for the entirety of this loop too?
: W...What?! Sensei and I don’t-
: Oh, come on Makoto. You don’t have to hide it. We already know.
: Sensei even has you shoving a dildo into your mouth as his wallpaper.
: You said you would delete that!
: I say a lot of things.
: Maybe you could use a sex toy or five as well if you’re going to be all grumpy like this.
: Well sorry for not having a trillion years to come to terms with the fact that the man I’m in love with is also sleeping with everyone else. No offense, Makoto.
: Oh...uhh...none taken?
: Then...I guess this means the two of you are also-
: I am. Maya’s too afraid to let Sensei dick her down because she thinks it’ll make his brain ooze out of his ears.
: That’s...some confidence you’ve got there.
: While I am certainly confident, I can assure you that has little to do with it. It is for everyone’s best interest that I do not sleep with Sensei.
: It is also important to note that if I did sleep with Sensei and he did not die from it, that he’d no longer want to sleep with either of you ever again. The end.
: I like this side of you.
: I don’t. Apart from that outburst when Noriko came to class, you’ve always seemed rather...reserved.
: That is because my time is better spent on attempting to understand this world. Which, should things go according to plan, may come to involve you in some way.
: And I say that with full knowledge that things rarely ever go according to plan.
: What is this plan, though? How am I supposed to just carry on with my daily life knowing that I’m doomed to repeat the same school year for the rest of forever?
: What’s the sense in applying myself if I know there’s no purpose to it?
: Maybe just...don’t apply yourself then?
: It’s hard to give you directions when we don’t know if you’re going to remember any of this come the next cycle, but maybe just...hang out on the DL for now?
: Have fun and slack off. Shove some more dildos in your mouth. It’s not like there’s a time limit. The world is your sandbox.
: But also know that things might turn really horrible and really scary at any given moment. If they do and you find yourself in a situation like that, come to the rooftop as quickly as possible.
: Why...the rooftop? What’s so special about that place?
: Probably just a denpa trope. Either way, that’s where you’ll want to be.
: Do you have any more questions for now?
: Yes. Roughly one thousand of them.
: Oh.
: Well, that’s too many.

: But you can take down my number and text several of them to me. I’d much prefer to not spend a second longer in this room when it is evident the two of you have used it for countless sexual excursions.
: Oh, come on. It hasn’t been that many...
Maya and Makoto exchange contact information before the two senior female members of the Apocalypse Squad head back to the dorms.
And while I’m hesitant to add Makoto to the roster before she even makes it there (If she does make it there) I can’t help but acknowledge the possibility.
I’m not sure what, but there must be something I can do to make sure she doesn’t suffer the same fate as Yumi and Tsuneyo.
Makoto deserves to hang onto her memories just as much as the two of them did...and if there’s anything I can do to strengthen her grasp on them, I’ll do it.
: So, how do you feel knowing that this world is something out of a sci-fi novel? Excited?
: Well, to start, my head hurts. And I’m still half-expecting to wake up from this weird dream at any given moment.
: I can pinch you if you want?
: Hah...no. I know this is real. Somehow.
: It makes literally zero sense and goes against basically everything I have ever read, but there’s some sort of merit to it, if not only for the fact that things aren’t always entirely as they seem.
: And weirdly enough, I think this actually...helps explain certain things. I don’t know. I still have to try and wrap my head around it.
: All things considered, it kind of works out in the long run. I’ve been wanting a more important role in your life lately and this prevents me from having to assertively seize one.
: I’m not really sure how you’d do that in the first place.
: You would be if you paid more attention to things I handed you.
: What?
: What?
: What does that mean?
: What does what mean?
: When was the last time you-
: Here! Sign this one!
: You didn’t...
: Didn’t what? Trick you into signing a marriage license by weaving it in with a bunch of tests? Do you really think I would do something like that?
: I'm Makoto! I'm the good one!
: Would the old Makoto do that? No. Of course not. But the new Makoto? Who has nothing to lose and little direction? I’m not so sure.
: Would marrying me really be so bad? I mean, we’re basically married already with how much time we spend together.
: I’m going to burn down your room.
: Who says it’s in my room?
: Makoto-
: Heheh! It’s fun having something to lord over you! Is this how you’ve felt the entire time you’ve kept that ridiculous photo of me as your wallpaper?
: There is no way you could even turn something like that in without me present. I don’t believe it.

: Kumon-mi’s regulations regarding marriage became extremely lax during the second year of the space war. All I need is a signature that, honestly, I could have forged. Just like you suggested the other day.
: That was about essays. Not marriage licenses. I don’t want to marry you.
: I know that. Which is why I’m not going to turn in the document. I’m just going to hold it over your head so that you’re forced to be nicer to me. Ha-ha.
: But I’ve...actually been nice lately. I haven’t done anything wrong.
: Then you’ve got nothing to worry about.
: Me on the other hand? I don’t even know where to start with this.
: Maybe Ayane is right? Maybe I should just take this...cycle easy?
: Knowing the world isn’t going anywhere definitely takes a load off of my mind. And with how stressed I’ve been lately, a bit of relaxation sounds amazing.
: The only question is how I should relax...
: I know that look.
: Do you?
: I do. Or at least I hope I do.
: Did Ayane really have to spend an entire school year abstinent? That sounds horrible.
: Maya figured she somehow got roped into this by getting pregnant.
: You came inside her?
: Quite frequently.
: I see.
: Do you wanna cum inside me?
: Wait, just to be sure, if I do get pregnant, it won’t carry on into the next timeline or whatever, will it?
: While I don’t have a definitive answer to that, I can tell you that I’ve ejaculated inside many girls over the last few school years and still remain child-less.
: Wanna make it one more?
: You’re suddenly taking this way better than you were an hour ago...
: I suddenly have nothing to lose and a pretty good idea of how I want to spend my vacation away from reality.
: And I’m suddenly reminded of how thankful I am for a world like this in the first place...
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
Makoto’s lust has increased to [makoto_lust]!
